citations.quote:
[name="推进之王"]……
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_singleblunt", volume=0.9)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.03, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_hammer", volume=0.8)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_imp_rock_n",channel="HAMMER",delay=0.3,volume=0.8)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[Character(name="avg_npc_407_1#3$2")]
[name="推进之王"]小心一些，我们还没踏入高墙，博士不想看见有人受伤。
[Character(name="avg_npc_012")]
[name="罗德岛干员"] 好的……你们也是！
[character(name="avg_npc_233_1#4")]
[name="蔓德拉"]……一锤子把我的造物砸碎了？
[character(name="avg_npc_233_1#7")]
[name="蔓德拉"]这家伙……和维多利亚士兵一样可恶！
[character(name="avg_npc_233_1#8")]
[name="蔓德拉"]虽然我也没使什么力……尝尝这个！
[Character(name="avg_npc_012")]
[name="罗德岛干员"] 推进之王，闪开！
[playsound(key="$d_avg_drone")]
[delay]
[dialog]
[character]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_funnel", volume=0.4)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_funnel", channel="key",volume=0.4,delay=0.1)]
[delay(time=0.6)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_explo_n",volume=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$e_imp_rock_n",volume=0.8)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[Character(name="avg_npc_407_1#4$2")]
[name="推进之王"]……有人替我打掉了威胁？
[Character(name="avg_npc_407_1#1$2")]
[name="推进之王"]白轮，你看到是谁了吗？

contributions.description: 推进之王击碎蔓德拉造物，蔓德拉看见并继续向其攻击；现场交战。
